cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Grandad's embarrassed about the gazebo. Let's tell everyone the party moved indoors because the garden's unavailable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's already told Aunt Jean he set it on fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then we all say, 'Everyone's fine; we're celebrating indoors.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Jean wants him to explain it in his birthday speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's his opening sentence too. Then straight to thanking her for the trifle.
